Methods

ParseValue(ReadOnlySpan<char>, out int)

This parses a quoted string, handling escape characters, giving you the string with processed escape characters and how many character that took out of value. You must include the two quotes in value, it will read until the closing quote or the end of value.

public static string ParseValue(ReadOnlySpan<char> value, out int consumed)

value ReadOnlySpan<char>

The string to extract the quoted string from, it will read what it needs and with consumed you can know how much of it was this string.
